summary:
Renamed the 8 Stress Response and 13 Panic Response conditions so every one of the 21 names is exactly 2 CJK characters and is derived from its own English DESCRIPTION rather than from the English word. 9 names changed, 12 were audited and kept.

STRESS: 镇定 · 惊跳 · 恍惚 · 恼怒 · 颤抖 · 慌乱 · 泄气 · 失误
PANIC : 镇定 · 受惊 · 喧闹 · 躁动 · 脱手 · 猜忌 · 犹豫 · 怔住 · 掩蔽 · 尖叫 · 逃跑 · 发狂 · 木僵

I adopted 8 of your 11 proposals and overruled 3 with reasons:
(1) Mess Up 失手 -> 失误. 失手 in everyday Chinese most often means "dropped it by accident" — which is exactly Lose Item 脱手's meaning, so the two would cross-talk on a token carrying both icons; and 失手 is limited to manual slips while this condition fires on ANY skill roll, Command and Comtech included.
(2) Twitchy 抽搐 -> 躁动. Trimming to 抽搐 is not shorter, it is WRONG: 抽搐 is the clinical word for a convulsion, far more severe than "twitchy", and it would sit beside 颤抖 (Shakes) as a second involuntary-movement word. The description is a supply roll for air/ammo/power — you are too keyed up to be economical — so 躁动 is the state that produces it.
(3) Tunnel Vision 恍惚 -> 失神 -> 恍惚. I first overruled 恍惚 because 恍 is a near-homograph of 慌 in the sibling 慌乱, then my own self-gate caught 失神 sharing its WHOLE leading character with the sibling 失误 in the same 8-row table. An identical first character costs a reader more than two merely similar ones, and 慌乱/恍惚 still differ completely in the second character — so your original 恍惚 stands. Both reversals are recorded in the notes and in R25's counter_argument.

Your key insight held up everywhere it mattered: 失去知觉 was not merely long, it was FACTUALLY WRONG (the row says the character rambles and stares, so they are conscious), and 搞砸/失去物品 both failed the "reads as a state" test.

⚠ Your requested check — 怔住 vs 木僵 do NOT read as the same state. 怔住 is transient shock (one lost turn), 木僵 is unresponsive stupor (until panic ends); they share no character and the severity ordering 怔住 < 木僵 is intuitive. This is in fact why Freeze had to move OFF 呆滞: once Catatonic became 木僵, 呆滞 and 木僵 would both have read as "unresponsive dullness" in the same 13-row table. 僵住 was rejected for Freeze for the same reason — it shares 僵 with 木僵.

The ⚠ pair is fully enumerated and locked: all 7 SAME_STRING_GROUPS pairs (BERSERK/Frenzy, TREMBLE/Shakes, FLEE/Flee, FREEZE/Freeze, SCREAM/Scream, SEEK COVER/Seekcover, CATATONIC/Catatonic) are now byte-identical in Chinese on both sides. I also found the "…" you left open: the SPACESHIP panic table's ShipPanic11 label is the English word "Freeze:" and ShipPanic8 is "Tremble:", byte-equal to the Freeze/Shakes glossary keys but NOT named in SAME_STRING_GROUPS — I moved ShipPanic11 with Freeze so one English word does not render two Chinese in one product.

Both required tools pass: assemble_lang.py "INVARIANTS: all 11 pass" (590 en keys, 584 covered, 6 deliberately unwritten, 16 code-only, 600 written); prep_sys_units.py --collect wrote the pack (page 35474 chars). I also ran build_glossary_v1.py, since the glossary is lockstep place (c): "INVARIANTS: all 16 pass over 404 terms". Nothing was hand-edited in lang/cn.json or the assembled pack.

changes.key_or_row: Keeping Cool — Stress Response 0-0 AND Panic Response 0-0 (result name only; no lang key, keepingcool is on alienrpg.mjs:267's toRemove list)
changes.why: ADOPTED your proposal. 4 chars, the only over-wide row in either table. 镇定 is 2 chars and level with the other 20.
changes.description_evidence: "No effect." — nothing to encode beyond composure, so the shortest correct word wins.

changes.why: ADOPTED your proposal, after a reversal and a reversal back (see summary). 视野狭窄 is 4 chars AND points at the wrong organ — the penalty is mental, not visual. 恍惚 (as in 精神恍惚) is 2 chars and is exactly 'cannot think straight'.
changes.description_evidence: "All skill rolls based on Wits get –2 dice." — Wits governs Observation / Survival / Comtech, i.e. thinking and perceiving, not eyesight.

changes.why: OVERRULED your 失手. Two reasons: (a) in everyday Chinese 失手 most often means 'dropped it by accident' — that is Lose Item 脱手's meaning, and a token can carry both icons; (b) 失手 is limited to manual slips, while this condition fires on ANY skill roll including Command and Comtech. 失误 is action-agnostic and unambiguous. Your reading of 搞砸 as colloquial is right and it is gone either way.
changes.description_evidence: "Your action fails regardless of what you rolled and you gain +1 stress level." — the name is the botch itself, and it is not restricted to physical actions.

changes.why: OVERRULED your 抽搐. Trimming is not the fix here — 抽搐 is the clinical word for a convulsion/seizure, a far more severe and quite different event, and it would stand beside 颤抖 (Shakes) as a second involuntary-movement word. 躁动 (restless agitation) is the state, not a symptom.
changes.description_evidence: "Make an immediate supply roll for air, ammo, or power." — you are too keyed up to be economical, so you burn through supplies. 抽搐 says nothing about that; 躁动 explains it.

changes.why: ADOPTED your proposal and your reasoning verbatim. Still deliberately NOT equal to DROP ITEM 扔下物品 (Panic9) — SAME_STRING_GROUPS does not pair them.
changes.description_evidence: "In combat, you can pick up the item with a quick action" — it is DROPPED, not lost. Description body also nudged to 「你脱手失去一件武器或其他重要物品」so the name and the text agree.

changes.why: ADOPTED. 疑神疑鬼 is a 4-char idiom about seeing threats everywhere, which is wider than the mechanic. 猜忌 is specifically distrust of one's OWN side. Runner-up 多疑 rejected as pointing at threats rather than at allies.
changes.description_evidence: "You cannot give or receive help on skill rolls until panic ends." — the mechanic is about refusing your teammates, which is what 猜忌 names.

changes.key_or_row: Freeze — ALIENRPG.freeze + Panic Response 7-7 (+ lockstep FREEZE)
changes.why: ADOPTED. 呆滞 means dull/vacant and never says the character cannot act; and once Catatonic becomes 木僵, 呆滞 and 木僵 read as the same unresponsive stupor in one 13-row table. 僵住 rejected for sharing 僵 with 木僵. ⚠ This overturns a level-4 stratum-A anchor (cn.json Panic10), done deliberately under ruling R21 — the reason is distinguishability, not style.
changes.description_evidence: "You're frozen by fear, losing your next turn and unable to perform any interrupt actions." 怔住 = stunned rigid by shock. Description also changed from 「你被恐惧冻住」to 「你因恐惧而怔住」.

changes.key_or_row: Seek Cover — ALIENRPG.seekcover + Panic Response 8-8 (+ lockstep SEEK COVER)
changes.why: ADOPTED, and your 'it is an action not a description' point is the load-bearing one. 掩蔽 is the standing military 2-char verb and keeps the 掩 of Cover 掩护 visible, so the relation reads off the glyphs. 隐蔽 rejected: that is concealment, while this game's Cover is a physical barrier.
changes.description_evidence: "You immediately seek (full) cover in the zone… Once in cover, your stress level is reduced 1 step" — the condition is the resulting state of being under cover.

changes.key_or_row: Catatonic — ALIENRPG.catatonic + Panic Response 12-20 (+ lockstep CATATONIC)
changes.why: ADOPTED, and this is the one that was not merely long but wrong. 木僵 is the standing clinical Chinese for catatonia, and the English 'Catatonic' is equally clinical, so the register matches. 瘫倒 was considered and rejected for dropping the 'cannot be roused' half.
changes.description_evidence: "You collapse to the floor and can't move, rambling or staring blankly into oblivion" — a character who rambles is CONSCIOUS, so 失去知觉 stated a falsehood.

changes.key_or_row: ALIENRPG.Panic10 <b> label + body, and Panic Table 10-10 description (classic FREEZE row)
changes.why: LOCKSTEP with Freeze. SAME_STRING_GROUPS pairs FREEZE/Freeze; the English differs in case only but the Chinese must be identical. Body 「因恐惧或压力而呆滞一轮」also moved so the prose does not contradict its own label.
changes.description_evidence: Same row, same state, two editions' names.

open_issues: SAME_STRING_GROUPS IS DECLARED BUT NEVER ENFORCED IN THE EQUALITY DIRECTION. build_glossary_v1.py invariant #14 fails only when two terms SHARE a value without being declared; a declared group whose members have DIVERGED passes silently. I had to write a ruling for each side of every pair by hand (R20/R20b, R21/R21b, R24/R24b) and prove the equality in my own gate. Recommend a 17th invariant: for every group, assert all present members have identical cn. Without it the very drift the group list exists to stop cannot be caught by the build.

SHIPPANIC IS BOUND BY THE SAME LOCK BUT IS NOT IN THE GROUP LIST. lang/en.json ShipPanic11's label is the English word "Freeze:" and ShipPanic8's is "Tremble:" — byte-equal to the Freeze and Shakes glossary keys — yet SAME_STRING_GROUPS names neither. I moved ShipPanic11 with Freeze on the same-English-same-Chinese principle; ShipPanic8 was already 颤抖 and needed nothing. Suggest extending the two group entries to name the ShipPanic labels so a future pass cannot split them.

6-工作区/phase1/OVERLAP-ADJUDICATION.json still records the PRE-rename ShipPanic11 value in rows.ALIENRPG.ShipPanic11.kept and .values.core (both containing 呆滞). I left it alone deliberately — it is a record of a past adjudication, and rewriting it would rewrite history — but it is now stale against the slice. Tell me if you want it refreshed with a dated amendment instead.

KEEPING COOL HAS NO GLOSSARY TERM AND NO LANG KEY, and still does not. It exists only as the 0-0 result name of both Evolved tables (keepingcool is on alienrpg.mjs:267's toRemove list, so there is no ALIENRPG.* value at all), and build_glossary_v1.py hard-exits on a ruling naming a term it cannot find. I recorded 镇定 in RULINGS.ui_label_rulings as R28. If you want it in the glossary proper it needs a term constructed in glossary_additions, which is a build-script change I did not make unasked.

TUNNEL VISION WAS DECIDED, REVERSED, AND RE-DECIDED WITHIN THIS PASS (恍惚 -> 失神 -> 恍惚). Your original proposal stands, but the audit trail in lang-core.notes.json and in R25's counter_argument records both directions on purpose, so the next reader does not re-litigate it. If you disagree with the second reversal, the single character to change is ALIENRPG.tunnelvision in the lang-core slice plus Stress 2-2 in SYS-T1 plus R25.

RULING ID NUMBERING COLLIDED WITH A CONCURRENT AGENT. RULINGS.json gained R5-heavy-machinery / R6-ranged-combat / R8-water while I was working, so I moved my block to R20-R28. My gate now asserts the CN delta mirrors the EN delta rather than demanding CN equality, so it will not be 'fixed' into a real defect later.
